nodes.name: Airtable: Scraped_Intel
nodes.notes: Create a table 'Scraped_Intel' in Airtable with columns: Source URL (URL), Scraped At (Date), Kind (Single select: product_page,competitor_ad,trend_item,review), Title, Description (Long text), Destination Kind, Destination Ref, Job ID (Number), Raw JSON (Long text)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ job_id: $('Normalize to ScrapedItem').item.json.job_id, status: 'success', item_count: 1, airtable_record_ids: [$json.id] }) }}

importInstructions: 1. Create 'Scraped_Intel' table in Airtable (see Airtable node notes for columns)
2. Replace REPLACE_WITH_AIRTABLE_BASE_ID with your base ID (e.g. appvPrfjiuXIhdNuW)
3. Replace REPLACE_WITH_SCRAPED_INTEL_TABLE_ID with the table ID
4. Set Airtable PAT credential (use existing 'Airtable account' credential if present)
5. Set Header Auth credential 'n8n Webhook Token' with name=X-Webhook-Token, value=$N8N_WEBHOOK_TOKEN
6. Confirm n8n container has FIRECRAWL_API_KEY and N8N_WEBHOOK_TOKEN env vars (restart container after .env update)
